lines: Lemmings normally can't swim, so water is a death trap for them unless you've got Swimmers! The Swimmer is a permanent skill with which they can cross any pond or river.

In some levels, there are also deadly traps which kill Lemmings who walk into their trigger area. Disarmers can deactivate them for good. Like the Swimmer, the Disarmer is a permanent skill. Disarming takes a few seconds, but the trap becomes harmless immediately.
